title: Learning to Detect Label Errors by Making Them: A Method for Segmentation and Object Detection Datasets
mechanism: Inject typed label errors into ground truth, train an instance-segmentation network on a composite (image, label, prediction) input to find error regions.
adaptation: Inject the audit's error types (dropped crack segments, spurious lines, shifted tracing, crack/inactive swaps) into train cells; detector input = EL image + given label + OOF prediction; apply to all 532 cells.
min_experiment: Arm: learned error detector. Baseline: ensemble ranking arm. Metric: precision on held-out injected errors and at 24 audit cells. Kill: not better than ensemble ranking at 24.
evidence: R: beats task-specific baselines on simulated errors across tasks; releases 459 real Cityscapes label errors.
